nodes.summary: Let $F$ be the free group on $x, y$, let $\mathbb{C}F$ be its complex group algebra, and for nonzero complex numbers $a, b$ let $\chi$ be the character of $F$ with $\chi(x) = a$ and $\chi(y) = b$. The map $\vartheta_{a,b}$ sends $\alpha = \sum_{g \in F} c_g\, g \in \mathbb{C}F$ to $\sum_{g \in F} \chi(g)\, c_g\, g$.
